linkedGuides.title: Chestnut Street Station waiting areas and restroom approach
linkedGuides.description: The agency’s station gallery shows covered bus bays, curb edges and red patterned curbside strips, benches outside and along the indoor hall, restroom-direction signs and the recessed restroom approach, and a meeting room with movable tables and chairs. Eleven photographs were inspected, including maintenance-area views that are not public boarding routes. Capture dates are unknown; the March 2026 asset paths are not photo dates. No restroom interior, adult changing equipment, measured doorway clearance, current boarding equipment or continuous parking route is established. A night exterior includes snow.

linkedGuides.title: LeBlond playground ramp, path and indoor court
linkedGuides.description: CRC’s four-photo slideshow includes a playground ramp with handrails, adjoining play-surface transitions, a curving paved outdoor path beside a wall, an indoor court with doors and folded equipment, and a cropped building facade. Capture dates are unknown. The facade omits the ground-level approach; the other views do not establish measured grades, the full parking-to-playground route, equipment transfer access, door operation, toilets or current conditions.

linkedGuides.title: Historical taproom tables, chairs and lighting
linkedGuides.description: This photograph accompanies Visit Cincy / meetNKY’s May 24, 2023 preview. It shows closely arranged wood tables, separate chairs with backs, higher bar seating, a window-side counter, ceiling decorations and several light sources. Exact capture date is unknown. It does not establish table heights, wheelchair clearances, current layout, noise or a quiet area. The original tourism article remains linked; no image is republished by Threshold.

linkedGuides.title: Historical restroom sink and doorway view
linkedGuides.description: This photograph accompanies Visit Cincy / meetNKY’s May 24, 2023 preview. It shows two wall-mounted sinks with visible pipes below, a mirror, towel dispenser, waste bin and a closed wooden door with a pull handle. Exact capture date is unknown. The toilet, doorway opening, turning space and changing facilities are outside the view; sink clearance, reach, door force and present conditions cannot be determined.

linkedGuides.title: Dayton storefront entrances, shop floor and creator-space seating
linkedGuides.description: Three store photographs show the recessed entrances, a sign directing visitors from the left door to the other entrance, the sidewalk edge and freestanding sign, book displays on a black-and-white patterned floor, and tables, stools, chairs and upholstered seating in the creator space. Capture dates are unknown. The doorway interiors and full threshold are not clearly shown; the images do not establish a step-free entrance, aisle or table clearances, stage access, toilet facilities or current layout. The crawl organizer separately reports an entrance step.

pdfReview: All eight application pages screened visually; mostly unextractable outlined text. The 21-day passage failed the fresh helper gate and was not imported. Both holiday schedule pages visually inspected with date/office/service columns intact; four seasonal notes passed the fresh text gate. Neither document is presented as a photo guide.
